$comment: Global SEO settings for the whole site. Everything here is deliberately a
file and not an admin-panel screen: these change once a year, and a wrong
value (a bad canonical domain, a stray verification tag) can de-index the
site — so they are reviewed in a pull request, not in a text box.
Blank values are simply not emitted. Add a value and it appears; clear it
and the tag disappears. Nothing here needs a code change to take effect.
The URL can also come from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, which wins over the value
below — that is how preview deployments get their own address.
